scope_guards: The structured candidate range remains 500-860 net dwellings.
The structured not-permissioned state is preserved.
The approximately 157 replacement social-rent homes are located on separate decant sites and are not additive to DM.
Millard Terrace's existing 156 units are existing stock and are not added as future growth capacity.
The GBP65.242m budget, HRA borrowing and assumed GLA grant are finance evidence, not planning permission or land value.
The adopted SPD's over-1,000-home figure is a wider transformation-area vision, not the exact DM parcel capacity.
CPO, vacant-possession and acquisition steps are not exact HMLR title/proprietor topology.
No score or promotion is written until site permission, exact geometry, title relation and overlays are verified.
